_comment: Exclusion list for very large apps (Smart Life, Tapo) on machines where the VSA runs out of heap: exclude.json plus libraries unrelated to the device/cloud protocol (reflection, JSON, annotations, image loading, ByteDance/Lynx UI, Stripe payments, Facebook SDK; trackers are covered by Exodus/MobSF). Select with VSA_EXCLUDE=/vsa/config/exclude_large.json or IOTSCOPE_EXCLUDE=/analysis/config/iotscope/exclude_large.json.
_warning: Never exclude the app's own code. Its package can differ from the app id (com.rainbow.drone keeps its code in mobi.heyemoji.*): check the Application/Activity class names in the manifest before adding entries. Keep the vendor code (com.tplink.*, com.thingclips.*, com.tuya.*), the Matter SDK (chip.*), networking (okhttp3, netty) and Google Play services in.
